entries.title: mobile-build/ios/1.4.12/40/958124356d6cada11486e34297c20d477d3a0e03: Fix the iOS release build and the Google Play feature check (#12967)
entries.note: Make the react-native-screens 4.30.1 patch again from the 4.30.1 source. Two hunks for RNSScreenStackHeaderConfig.mm had the line numbers of the old version. Bun applies a hunk at its line number and does not check the context, so the patched file did not compile and the iOS archive failed. Declare android.hardware.screen.portrait and android.hardware.wifi as not required. The portrait orientation and the ACCESS_WIFI_STATE permission of expo-network made Google Play mark them as required, and Play stopped the review of 1.4.12. These native changes make a new runtime version for Android and iOS. Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com
